translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Corintios
book.title: Corintogi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Corintios

content: Bab-dummadga-imaklegedse mer gormalo
Gwenadgan, bemar nue insamalo, igi Bab Dummad mogir-urba anmar-dadgan-semai-gusa, degi, igi Demar-Ginnid-nugad-abargi obaksamala, deun demar ega dinnaa imaksagu.
Degisoggu, bela anmar-dadgan mogirgine, degine, demargine, Bab-Dummad-digi-oglesmaladyob Moisés-igarba nagusmalad.
Deginbali, bela anmar-dadgan mas-burbaled guchadbimarbalid.
Degine, bela amar gobed-burbaled gobsadbimarbalid, ar ade akwa-burbaled eba nadap-gusad, agi dii-ainied gobsamalad. Ar we-akwa Cristo-sunnadid.
Ar degi-inigwele, anmar-dadgan bur-melu Bab-Dummad-yeer-ito imaksasurmalad, degisoggu, a-ular nega-dule-sulidganba anmar-dadgan burgwismarsunnad.
Ar we-ibmarmar-gusadi, anmar-odurdakega deyob gusad, adi anmar mer ibmar-iskanabina sogegar, igi anmar-dadgan ibmar-iskanabina sogsamaladyob.
Degine, melle binsa bab-dummadga-imaklegedse be gormalo, igi war-wargwen be-dadgan gusmaladyob. Weyob Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naid:
Degine, melle na be abirgunagwarsuli na be neg-sichigi yoledigumalo, igi be-dadgan gwenna-gwenna degi-gusmala, deun a-ulale mili-dulagwen-gakapaa ibagwen burgwis-gusmalad.
Degine, melle Bab-Jesús-wilubdaknai-gumarbalo, igi gwenna-gwenna be-dadgan Bab-Dummad-wilubdakbi-guarmalana, deun a-ular naibe-buledgi bukidar warmaksamalad, degi, burgwis-gusmalad.
Degi, melle Bab Dummadgi urwar be sunmakmalo, igi be-dadgan wargwen-wargwen Bab Dummadgi urwar sunmaksamala, a-ular anger-dule-oburgwedse anmar-dadgan-oburgwiles-gusmalad.

Ar we-ibmar bela degi-gusadi, anmarga oyonaid, adi anmar mer deyob damalagar, degine, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naibalid, adi anmarga sogegar, nue salakarmarye, anmar emi neg-dukumosadgi dula-gudidimaladgar.
Degisoggu, ar dule Bab-Jesús-igargi gannasgwaa na nanadii-itogele, nue salakar, mer iskued sao.

Be wilubdaklear sogele, be binsao, we-wilubdaklegedgi, baigan wilubdaklesmogad. Ar Bab Dummad gwen galakumaisursoggu, anmarga-wilubdakleged-nagumaid ise-anmargi obichaa-imaked imakosulid. Wilubdakleged anmargi noni-sogele, Bab Dummad anmarga igar-egabaloed, adi anmar wilubdaklegedgi wakinnegar, mer ese galakuegar.
Degisoggu gwenadgan, an na be-sabemalad, bab-dummadga-imaklegedse-goledgi be wakinmarsun.
Bemar binsaed-nue-nikaa damaladsoggu, an-ibmar-bega-soged, na be-sunnad egi nue be binsamarmogoed, wede ib-nued-dibe, igi, wede ib-iskana-dibe.

Anmar uva-nis gobbalile, Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye sogsale, ¿ar wede soglesursi, Cristo-abe-milesadba anmar bato Cristogadmoye? Deginbali, anmar madu-gunnega burwi-burwi mimmialile, ¿ar wede soglesursi, bato anmar Cristogadye?
Anmar ichesur gumar-inigwele, unnila madu-wargwennaa an guchamalad. Debayobi, anmar ichesulid, san-wargwennaa Cristogi anmar gunonimarmogad.
Emi Israel-dorgan be dakena, Bab-Dummadga-galugi-ibmar-gummakar-uksamalad guchamalar, ¿oyonaisursi, Bab-Dummadba-mesa akanonimarye?
Emide, ¿igi an sogsunna? ¿An sogsi, binsa bab-dummadga-imakleged, we gangued-nikaye? ¿An sogsi, binsa bab-dummadga-imaklegedga ibmar-gummakar-ukleged we ib-nuedye? Suli, degi an sogsuli.
An sognaido, Judiosurmalad ibmar-gummakar-ukmalad, we niaga ukmarye, Bab Dummadgarsurye. An bemar-abesurdo, niaba bemar akanai-gued.
Ar geg bemar Bab-Jesús-nog gobnai, degi, nia-nog gobnai-gubalid. Degine, Bab-Jesús-mesagi mas-gunsii, degi, nia-mesagi mas-gunsii geg bemar gumarbalid.
¿Ar ade bemargi Bab Dummad nobgubi be abemarsi? ¿Ar ade anmar Bab Dummadba bur dutusursi? Suli, degisuli.
Bela be ibmar saedi, Bab-Dummad-nug-odummogega be imakmar
Belagwapa sunna ibmar an saed, degi-inigwele, belagwapa ibmar-nueganbisulid. Belagwapa sunna ibmar an saed, degi-inigwele, belagwapa ibmar-nueganbi anga guosulid.
Melle na be dukin begadbi-ibmar-nued-imakedgi be binsamalo, suli, aimar-baigangi be binsamarmogoed.
San-ukleged-neggi bela san-ukleged be gunmar, mer be egismar wede binsa bab-dummadga-imaklegedga we-san ukles sogeye, adi be-ulubgi mer be ichakwa be itogegar.

Dule-wargwen-Bab-Jesúsba-naisulid mas-gunnega bese gochale, be nabiele, be naoed. Bela bega mas-gunned ukalile, be gunnoed, mer be egisoed, we bab-dummadga-imaklegedga ukles sogeye, ar adi mer ichakwa ulubgi be itogegar.
Ar dule-wargwen bega sokalirdi: “We-mas, bab-dummadga-imaklegedga uklesye,” adi mer be gunnoed, ar dule bega sogsad-ular, degine, ulubgi egi be binsaed-ular.

An sogedi, be-ulubgi-binsaed-ular an sogsulid. Suli, dule-baid-ulubgi-binsaed-ular an soged. Dule-wargwen sunna sogdagoed: “¿Ibiga an wargwen yeer-itodiid dule-baid angi akar-binsaed-ular angi ichakwa sunmakledagoe?
Ar Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye mas-gunned-idu an sogele, ¿ibiga degite angi ichakwa sunmakledabalosunna, ar mas-gunned-iduar dog-nuedye Bab Dummadga an sogsasursi?”
Degisoggu, be mas gun-dibe, igi, be gob-dibe, ibu be imak-dibe, bela Bab-Dummad-nug-odummogega imaked be sae.
Judiomar-dibe, degi, Judiosurmalad-dibe, igi, Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-dibe, mer be-nuggi iskuega be imakoed.
Andi an gudigu, bela an ibmar-saedi, dulemar-baigan yeer-ito an imakbied, unnila anginbi an binsabisulid, adi bukidar Bab-Jesúsba abonolemarmogagar.
